add_library(d3d9 SHARED ${DXVK_SOURCES} ${BMSVR_SOURCES})
set_target_properties(d3d9 PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME d3d9 PREFIX "")
target_compile_definitions(d3d9 PRIVATE WIN32 NDEBUG INFRA_EXPORTS _WINDOWS _USRDLL NOMINMAX)
target_compile_options(d3d9 PRIVATE /MP /W3 /EHsc)
target_include_directories(d3d9 PRIVATE
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/include
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/src
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/src/d3d9
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/src/d3d9/shaders
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/include/shaders
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/sdk
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/thirdparty/minhook/include
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/thirdparty/openxr/include
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/thirdparty/vulkan/include
  "C:/Users/Henning/Documents/cursor/black mesa/reference/portal2vr/thirdparty/openvr/include"
)
if(DEFINED ENV{DXSDK_DIR})
  target_include_directories(d3d9 PRIVATE
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/include
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/src
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/src/d3d9
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/src/d3d9/shaders
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/include/shaders
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/sdk
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/thirdparty/minhook/include
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/thirdparty/openxr/include
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/thirdparty/vulkan/include
  "C:/Users/Henning/Documents/cursor/black mesa/reference/portal2vr/thirdparty/openvr/include"
)
  target_link_directories(d3d9 PRIVATE "$ENV{DXSDK_DIR}/Lib/x86")
endif()
target_link_directories(d3d9 PRIVATE
  ${DXVK_ROOT}/lib32
  "C:/Users/Henning/Documents/cursor/black mesa/reference/portal2vr/thirdparty/openvr/lib/win32"
  ${BMSVR_ROOT}/thirdparty/openxr/pkg/native/Win32/release/lib
)
target_link_libraries(d3d9 PRIVATE vulkan-1 openxr_loader)
target_link_options(d3d9 PRIVATE "/DEF:${DXVK_ROOT}/src/d3d9/d3d9.def")
